transcript.text: Northside Dental, this is Ava. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning.
Happy to sort that out. Any discomfort or pain right now, or is this a routine cleaning?
No pain, just routine. It's been about eight months.
Perfect. I have Thursday the sixth at 10:15 in the morning, or Friday the seventh at 3:30 in the afternoon. Which suits you better?
Thursday the sixth at 10:15 it is. Can I take the best number to reach you on?
Four one five, five five five, oh one eight eight.
Got it, 415-555-0188. I've booked you in with Dr. Lang. You'll get a text confirmation within the hour, and we'll send a reminder the day before. Anything else I can help with?
Thanks for calling Northside Dental. See you Thursday.
